answer: When the wheels is ready, the milk carrier wraps the wheels in muslin dusted with flour, shaking the flour off the muslin before the wrap. Whey rennet curd ladler butter warrant covers the wrapping: a warrant rennet curd ladlers show after ladling vat trials. The relic marks the wrapping, the jetty marks the muslin, the zenith marks the wheels. A counterfeiter would fake 11 muslins and 11 wrappings.
